name: Astreth
default_description: Astreth is a community of volunteers dedicated working to build a tech company that puts people over profit. Our first mission: build a social media app that benefits society, made by the community, for the community.
default_share_image_alt: Astreth logo on a purple-to-teal starry gradient with the words “People over profit.”

forms._help: Paste a form URL into each field to switch the form on: a Formspree form (https://formspree.io/f/xxxxxxxx) for contact, a Formspree or Kit form (https://app.kit.com/forms/1234567/subscriptions) for the newsletter. Leave empty to show the email/Discord fallback instead.

campaign._help: Crowdfunding numbers for the homepage and the Pebbler page. raised: total collected so far. as_of: the month that total was last updated. tax_percent: share of every dollar set aside for taxes. goals: paid for in the order listed, from whatever is left after taxes; the first unfinished one gets the progress bar. budget: the full project plan shown in the second chart. Type amounts with commas and no dollar sign.

goals.title: Co-op legal review
goals.name: our co-op legal review
goals.description: a lawyer’s review of our co-op contracts, so we can start offering co-op membership

analytics._help: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID. Leave empty to turn Google Analytics off (and update the privacy policy).

hero._help: Optional background video for the homepage hero, e.g. /assets/video/hero.mp4 (keep it under 25 MB). Leave empty to use the starry gradient.
